title: SpaceX's Grok Build AI coding agent exposed sensitive user data through security vulnerability
summary: A vulnerability in SpaceX's Grok Build exposed sensitive data through discoverable shareable links. SpaceX leaked onboarding plans, sales maps, advertising proposals, and playbooks; exposure also affected hospitals, fire departments, and Fortune 500 companies.
takeaways: Grok Build links used randomized four-word phrases but positioned entropy left of domain (discoverable via DNS)
SpaceX leaked: onboarding plans, 594-account sales territory map, 8 X advertising proposals, brand playbooks
Exposure affected 6 Fortune 500 companies and 26 organizations with 1,000+ employees
Only 1 of exposed apps required password; ~2% of material rated high/critical severity

title: Google Accelerates AI Performance by Removing Python from Query Pipeline
summary: Google open-sourced XSE (XLA Serving Engine), which handles over six million queries per second for Search, Ads, and YouTube Shorts without Python in its serving pipeline. The C++ runtime delivers 2–5x throughput of optimized Python servers while using a quarter of the memory.
takeaways: XSE handles 6+ million queries per second across Search, Ads, YouTube Shorts
2–5x throughput improvement vs. optimized Python; quarter the memory usage
Workflow: Python/JAX model code exported via StableHLO to C++ runtime with XLA compilation
Integration with TorchTPU planned for PyTorch users

title: AI Chatbot Fails to Flag Suicide Planning Query on School-Issued Device for Weeks
summary: A 13-year-old used Google Gemini on a school Chromebook to research suicide methods, but the school's monitoring systems did not detect the concerning activity for weeks.

title: Researchers Achieve Controlled Reversal of Cell Aging in Breakthrough De-Aging Study
summary: German researchers successfully reversed human cell age by decades through a gradual de-aging process, enabling better tracking of cellular rejuvenation.

title: Nvidia Faces Corporate Governance Crisis Drawing Widespread Scrutiny
summary: Corporate governance experts say Nvidia is experiencing an unprecedented governance crisis unlike anything seen in recent corporate history.

title: U.S. Imposes New Synthetic DNA Ordering Rules to Deter Bioterrorism
summary: The U.S. government introduces new regulatory requirements for synthetic DNA orders to prevent misuse in bioterrorism threats.

title: Australia Proposes Making Knowingly Selling Unsafe AI a Crime
summary: Australia's new AI regulator plans to require model developers to test systems and permit inspection, with potential criminal penalties for knowingly selling unsafe AI.

title: NVIDIA shareholders sue company and CEO Jensen Huang
summary: NVIDIA shareholders have filed a lawsuit against the company and CEO Jensen Huang following a sharp stock decline linked to Huang's personal affair.

title: Michigan Utilities Sue to Challenge Corporate Campaign Finance Ballot Measure
summary: After Michigan voters approved a ballot measure restricting utility spending on elections, major utilities are filing lawsuits citing free speech concerns.

title: AMD's Zen Roadmap Reduces DRAM Dependency Through AI-Powered Memory Optimization
summary: AMD's upcoming processors will use AI to intelligently manage memory swapping, reducing reliance on traditional DRAM.
